title: Minimum Cost For Tickets
summary: Given an integer array of travel days and the costs for three types of train tickets with specified durations, calculate the minimum total cost required to cover travel on all the given days.
statement: Given an integer array of travel days and the costs for three types of train tickets with specified durations, calculate the minimum total cost required to cover travel on all the given days.
constraints: days is strictly increasing; passes cover 1, 7, or 30 consecutive calendar days.
Return minimum cost covering every travel day.
hints: At each uncovered travel day, choose which duration pass begins there.
Memoize the minimum cost from a calendar day onward.
Skip nontravel days; on travel days minimize cost+solve(day+duration).
Every valid plan buys some pass for the first uncovered day, so the recurrence is exhaustive.
editorial: Every valid plan buys some pass for the first uncovered day, so the recurrence is exhaustive.

tests.explanation: A seven-day pass for days 1–7 plus one-day passes for 8 and 20 costs eleven.
Two seven-day passes and two one-day passes cost seventeen.
